summary: Centers Lab NJ, a New Jersey-based clinical diagnostics company, disclosed a breach affecting 542,377 individuals after unauthorized actors gained limited access to its systems between August 9–14, 2025, and copied sensitive data. The breach was detected on August 25, 2025, and investigated with third-party forensic specialists, with the company publishing its breach notice on June 18 (following several months of review and validation). Exposed data included names combined with dates of birth, Social Security numbers, driver's license or state ID numbers, passport numbers, health insurance information, and medical records. The company has implemented additional security safeguards and is advising affected individuals to monitor accounts and consider fraud alerts or credit freezes.
